# pai cd

Print a project's directory (the shell wrapper changes into it)

```
pai cd PROJECT
```

Needs the shell integration: add `eval "$(pai shell-init)"` to your shell profile. If the project moved on disk, the registry is updated.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PROJECT` | yes | Project name, slug or path |

```sh
pai cd my-project
cd "$(pai cd my-project)"
```

See also: `pai shell-init`
